scope: Only rank-trace module and printed theorem types/axioms, not whole zeta proportion theorem or external independent kernel replay.

theorem_types.rank_trace_ineq:
theorem RHLinalg.rank_trace_ineq.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : RCLike 𝕜] {n : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype n]
  [inst_2 : DecidableEq n] {P Q : Matrix n n 𝕜},
  P.PosSemidef →
    ∀ (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) {r b : ℕ},
      P.rank ≤ r →
        RHLinalg.posIndex hQ ≤ b →
          ∀ {c : ℝ},
            0 < c →
              c * RHLinalg.rtrace P - c ^ 2 / 4 * ↑r + 2 * c * RHLinalg.rtrace Q - c ^ 2 * ↑b ≤
                RHLinalg.frobSq (P + Q)
theorem_types.rank_trace_ineq_two:
theorem RHLinalg.rank_trace_ineq_two.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : RCLike 𝕜] {n : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype n]
  [inst_2 : DecidableEq n] {P Q : Matrix n n 𝕜},
  P.PosSemidef →
    ∀ (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) {r b : ℕ},
      P.rank ≤ r →
        RHLinalg.posIndex hQ ≤ b →
          2 * RHLinalg.rtrace P + 4 * RHLinalg.rtrace Q - 4 * ↑b - RHLinalg.frobSq (P + Q) ≤ ↑r
